rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿０８Yo!￥Wondered what you were doing on￥your day off, so I dropped by.
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿０９Hmm...￥So you're not training on￥your days off.＝＠０４７＿１０But your scores are good...
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１１Dammit!￥I was pretty confident this￥time, too!＝＠０４７＿１２How'd you pull off scores￥like that?
Just a fluke.
I worked hard.
Must've been a fluke.
I guess I worked hard.
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１３You're saying you beat me￥by a fluke?
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１４Is that supposed to be modest?￥Sounds like a dig to me.
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１５Well, still...
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１６Yeah... I guess so.￥You've been working hard too.￥It bugs me, but I'll admit it.
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１７You must have a knack for this.￥Your scores shot right up.￥That's awesome.
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１８Hey, got some kind of efficient￥way to train or something?
Nothing special, really.
Just focus hard, maybe?
Nothing special, really.
Just focus hard, maybe?
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿１９I see...￥So regular training's enough to￥aim for good scores, huh...
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿２０I know that, but...＝＠０４７＿２１I can focus like crazy on the￥stuff I'm good at.＝＠０４７＿２２It's the stuff I'm bad at where￥I just can't keep it up.
＊Eiji＊＠０４７＿２３Well, I'll give it a shot.￥Staying beaten by you would￥bug me too much.＝＠０４７＿２４Anyway, I'm gonna get going.￥Later!
